story.title: The Applause Engine
story.logline: A struggling street musician discovers a device that turns public silence into deafening applause, only to realize the crowd isn't real.
story.twist: The applause isn't coming from grateful listeners, but from his own dying heartbeat amplified through the device.
story.ending: When the battery finally dies, will anyone actually be listening to the silence left behind?

scenes.narration: Nobody clapped. Not a single person in this crowded subway station cared about my broken guitar.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 22, messy brown hair, wearing a worn green jacket, holding a beat-up acoustic guitar in a gritty subway station.
scenes.camera: Extreme close-up on Leo's face, tracking back slowly.

scenes.narration: Then I found the silver badge on the bench. No instructions, just a single pulsing red light.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 22, messy brown hair, green jacket, picking up a sleek metallic silver badge from a cold wooden bench.
scenes.camera: Over-the-shoulder shot looking down at Leo's hands.

scenes.narration: I pinned it to my lapel, struck a clumsy chord, and the world completely shattered around me.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 22, messy brown hair, green jacket, pinning the silver badge to his chest in the subway station.
scenes.camera: Medium shot, dynamic arc around Leo.

scenes.narration: Thunderous cheers exploded from empty platforms. Hundreds of invisible hands clapped in a deafening, frantic rhythm.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 22, messy brown hair, green jacket, looking shocked as he stands alone on an empty subway platform.
scenes.camera: Wide shot, spinning 360 degrees to show no one is there.

scenes.narration: I played faster. The roar grew louder, feeding my desperate soul the validation I always craved.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 22, messy brown hair, green jacket, aggressively strumming his guitar with a euphoric smile.
scenes.camera: Low angle looking up at Leo, energetic movement.

scenes.narration: Every stranger I passed smiled and bowed, caught in the invisible wave of absolute, unearned adoration.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 22, messy brown hair, green jacket, walking through a city street as people bow toward him.
scenes.camera: Tracking shot moving backward in front of Leo.

scenes.narration: Until the battery indicator blinked red, and the roaring applause suddenly began to sound remarkably familiar.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 22, messy brown hair, green jacket, staring down at the glowing badge with a sudden look of dread.
scenes.camera: Tight close-up on the blinking red light of the badge.

scenes.narration: It wasn't a crowd cheering. It was my own heartbeat, amplified and bounced back through the speakers.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 22, messy brown hair, green jacket, touching his chest in horror as the sound syncs with his pulse.

scenes.narration: The badge wasn't measuring my talent. It was stealing my life force to pay for the applause.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 22, messy brown hair, green jacket, looking pale and frail, trying desperately to pull the badge off.
scenes.camera: Extreme close-up on Leo's trembling fingers.

scenes.narration: The music stopped. The cheers vanished. When the silence returns, will anyone be left to listen?
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 22, messy brown hair, green jacket, standing completely alone in utter, dead silence as the badge goes dark.
scenes.camera: Wide static shot holding still on Leo's motionless figure.

caption.title: The Applause Engine
caption.caption: He finally found the crowd that would listen forever. But the louder they cheered, the weaker he felt. Is the echo of applause worth losing your life?
